episodeTitle.en: Mastering product strategy and growing as a PM | Maggie Crowley (Toast, Drift, TripAdvisor)
episodeTitle.zh: 《精通产品战略，成长为产品经理》| 玛吉·克劳利（Toast、Drift、TripAdvisor）

guestBioOfficial.en: Maggie Crowley is VP of product at Toast and previously vice president and head of product at Charlie Health, senior director of product management at Drift, and a PM at TripAdvisor. She’s also the host of Build, a podcast dedicated to product and product management. In today’s conversation, Maggie shares: • The value of building a broad-based PM skill set
guestBioOfficial.zh: 玛吉·克劳利是Toast的副总裁，此前曾在Charlie Health担任副总裁兼产品主管，在Drift担任产品管理高级总监，并在TripAdvisor担任产品经理。她还是致力于产品和产品管理的播客《Build》的主持人。在今天的对话中，玛吉分享了：• 建立广泛的PM技能的重要性

title.en: Mastering product strategy and growing as a PM | Maggie Crowley (Toast, Drift, TripAdvisor)
title.zh: 《精通产品战略，成长为产品经理》| 玛吉·克劳利（Toast、Drift、TripAdvisor）

summary.en: Maggie argues that when you catch yourself saying "that's not my job," it's usually exactly what you should do to move faster. She describes the PM as the emotional center of the team, responsible for keeping everyone motivated and optimistic. The episode is full of grounded advice on ownership, scrappiness, and doing whatever it takes to ship.
summary.zh: 玛吉认为，当你忍不住说"那不是我的活儿"时，那往往恰恰是你应该去做、从而更快推进的事。她把 PM 描述成团队的"情绪中心"，负责让大家保持动力与乐观。本期充满了关于主人翁意识、灵活务实以及"为交付不遗余力"的扎实建议。
